dependency_tiers.TECHNICALLY_REQUIRED: Camera will not boot, mount, power, or record without this item. Hard software block.
dependency_tiers.PRODUCTION_REQUIRED: Kit will fail in real field operations without this (e.g. rods for heavy zooms, stand for COB).
dependency_tiers.WORKFLOW_RECOMMENDED: Standard industry best-practice for reliability and crew operation (e.g. monitor for focus puller).
dependency_tiers.CONVENIENCE: Quality-of-life additions (e.g. quick-release plates, magic arms, D-Tap splitters).
dependency_tiers.OPTIONAL: Creative styling accessories (e.g. diffusion filters, spot projection lens, anamorphic adapter).

technically_required: CFexpress Type A or V90 SDXC card
workflow_recommended: Tilta Mirage Matte Box with VND
optional: Atomos Ninja V+ (for 4.2K 16-bit ProRes RAW recording)

technically_required: Canon RF-to-PL Adapter (if using PL glass)
Power Source (Dual BP-9XX or V-Mount with 2-pin LEMO)
production_required: SDI Monitor or SDI-to-HDMI Converter (no HDMI on camera body!)
workflow_recommended: Tilta / Outrigger Top Handle with Run/Stop
incompatible: Direct HDMI monitor cables without converter

technically_required: RED PRO CFexpress Type B Card (1TB/2TB)
Micro V-Mount or Standard V-Mount Battery
production_required: 12G-SDI Monitor or RED DSMC3 Touch LCD
workflow_recommended: Nucleus-M II / DJI Focus Pro Motor
incompatible: Non-approved consumer CFexpress B cards (cause recording lockups)

technically_required: DJI PROSSD 1TB or Approved CFexpress B
DL Mount Lens or DL-to-E Mount Adapter
workflow_recommended: Ronin 4D Flex Extension Cable (for handheld/jib use)
incompatible: External gimbals (DJI RS3/RS4 Pro - Ronin 4D IS a gimbal!)
Heavy cine lenses > 1.2kg (causes motor axis overload)

technically_required: PL Mount Camera Body or PL Adapter (PL-to-E or PL-to-RF)
production_required: Rigid Lens Support Bracket (MANDATORY SAFETY - prevents mount damage!)
workflow_recommended: Heavy Duty Fluid Head Tripod (Studio Assist)

technically_required: 100-240V AC Power Cord or Dual 26V/28.8V V-Mount Batteries
production_required: Heavy Duty Junior Stand (Combo Stand / Steel C-Stand)
workflow_recommended: Aputure Light Dome 150 or F10 Fresnel
Wireless Sidus Link Mesh App Control
incompatible: Lightweight aluminum light stands (dangerous collapse risk)

technically_required: 4x RP-SMA Dual-Band Antennas (Check antenna count upon dispatch & return!)
Power source (NP-F970 or D-Tap DC cable)
production_required: Micro/Full HDMI or SDI BNC cable + 1x BACKUP cable
workflow_recommended: Cold shoe ball head mount / NATO monitor arm
